License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE)

Kiwix reads byte strings through checked slices. Integer values and string
lengths are checked against their destination types before use. Ignored
integers are syntax-checked without a destination limit. The crate
forbids unsafe Rust. Existing tests use the same Ubuntu torrent metadata
fixture from the librqbit 9.1.0 published crate, now with a self-contained path.

4377c0ec9e28d582e0f3014d47916c5a6b949fd9da18ef87a729628c6546719f
